goal: Wave 3 build: Cited-passage viewer and provenance stamp; Wide research entry, estimate and org cap; Run now button in the hub; Full-draft preview on the approval card for mail sends (read-only); Agent-requested help on a login or bot check; Hand-back note and fresh snapshot; human input never reaches the model; Hand-back hygiene; Wait budget and expiry across a long takeover NOTE: run every pnpm command with the env var pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run=false. Typecheck the frontend with node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc6 -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit (tsconfig.json checks nothing). NOTE: every new switch defaults off; never flip one. A change to any .proto needs generated code: put the exact buf/regen step in lead_todo instead of hand-editing generated Go files, keep the change additive, and comment every new field and message (buf lint ratchet). NOTE: one model-gateway plus execution-core test build takes most of the free disk, so build only the test targets your slice names; never create a new cargo target directory, use only the given targetDir. NOTE: a change to a platform prompt or a tool definition must regenerate apps/Model Plane/rust/crates/mp-contracts/tests/fixtures/prompt-tool-manifest.json (MP_UPDATE_PROMPT_MANIFEST=1 cargo test -p mp-contracts --test prompt_tool_manifest) and add or update an eval case or replay cassette (scenario-touch gate). NOTE: Wave 3 is built in wave mode: build the code and its tests, log depth findings, no live stack and no docker (the lead runs docker). Live proofs go to the depth phase. NOTE: code first (owner order 2026-11-03): write the code and the unit tests the row names, do not run them; one guard agent compiles after the batch. session-core migrations taken: 0100, 0101, 0103, 0104, 0105 (EP-4-S5), 0106 (EP-12-S14) and any newer file in the migrations folder: take your reserved round-B number if still free, else the next free number; capability-core the next free at or above 0036. Never add zdr-posture-matrix rows for a feature refusal (rows are keyed on bearers and route only); use zdr_features.rs, the feature table and docs/ZDR.md. pytest and python-pptx are not installed. action-registry.test.ts P-SPA1 is main's pre-existing failure. Error bodies keep {error:{code,message,details}} with details an object. auth-core has ONE ApiKeyExchangeController serving every audience (merged from main 2026-11-04): extend it, never add a second exchange route.

slices.title: Agent-requested help on a login or bot check
slices.summary: With EXECUTION_BROWSER_HUMAN_ASSIST on, a strong login/captcha/consent/waf challenge that Quarry could not recover raises a browser_human_assist approval (assist_origin=agent, assist_kind=<kind>) instead of a BLOCKED result, at most twice per run. The card offers Take over (S1 control flip) and Skip this site (deny: model gets browser_help_declined and the session closes), with per-kind nb/en copy and host from the approval record only; attention/push text carries no host. No migration and no new proto fields beyond S1's.
slices.remaining: D1 (grant owner of record, decided with the Quarry session) gates the Take over button; without it the card could only offer Skip. Round B lists S2 under D1 unblocks. D4 (system-raised help only) and D9 (no cross-host sign-in) have recommended defaults.

slices.title: Hand-back hygiene
slices.summary: After a hand-back resume, a typed_by_person session flag drops the text of textbox, searchbox, combobox and spinbutton targets from every observation until the agent's next browser.open. The Do loop is pinned to never send persist_profile or a profile_id, and run end closes the Quarry run after hand-back. browser.open during a takeover is already refused by S1's TAKEN_OVER. No migration, proto or flag.

slices.title: Wait budget and expiry across a long takeover
slices.summary: Sets the approval TTL for browser_human_assist from EXECUTION_BROWSER_ASSIST_TTL_SECONDS (default 1800, clamp 300-3600), read once into service state. At resume the run grant is revalidated with the click-time browser bearer; an expired grant returns browser_session_lost. On APPROVAL_STATE_TIMED_OUT the model gets browser_help_timed_out and the session and Quarry run are released; with WS03-S8 park on and no fresh bearer the run parks with browser_credential_expired, otherwise CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED. No migration or proto change.
slices.remaining: Startable dark after S1 (D5 has a recommended default of 1800 s). The park branch uses WS03-S8 only if it is on; otherwise a CREDENTIAL_EXPIRED refusal. Q-5 (Quarry lease not idle-swept for 1800 s) affects the live proof, not the build.
